en: A monochrome winter scene of a European city square covered in snow. Leafless trees with frosted branches line a curved street around a fenced central area. In the background stands a tall church-like tower with a clock and a baroque-style spire. Historic multi‑story buildings flank both sides of the street. The card has printed captions at the top and a purple archival stamp with a handwritten year at the bottom right.
